strings.eapFullFormBudgetDescription1: Provide the EAP budget as a separate attachment
strings.eapFullFormBudgetDescription2: Use the IFRC standard budgeting template for Early Action Protocol
strings.eapFullFormBudgetDescription3: Following the same order (and output codes) as in the operational matrix filled in the EAP activation process section...
strings.eapFullFormReadinessCostDescription1: For each item of readiness costs in the budget, explain why these are necessary for the upkeep of the EAP and how these were calculated.
strings.eapFullFormReadinessCostDescription2: Indicate who will manage these funds and describe how it will be ensured that they are only used for the indicated purposes.
strings.eapFullFormPrePositioningDescription1: Explain for which items (if any) the pre-positioning funds are requested. Mention why no other option is possible.
strings.eapFullFormPrePositioningDescription2: Expiry date of the items should not be prior to the end of the lifecycle of the EAP
strings.eapFullFormPrePositioningDescription3: Provide information about the location of the storage facilities and costs of storage, etc.
strings.eapFullFormEarlyActionCostDescription1: In the budget, list all these costs under the section early action costs.
strings.eapFullFormEarlyActionCostDescription2: If any early action costs are listed in the budget, indicate activation procedures including who initiates the funds request, approval chain/procedures and process of disbursement including...
strings.eapFullFormEapEndorsementDescription: Describe by whom, how and when the EAP was agreed and endorsed.
